modelo_ou_modo: Imagem, Qualidade 2.0, x4, 4:3; edicoes pela caixa 'Descreva sua edicao'
prompt: a seaside amusement park with a Ferris wheel and a carousel with 5 characters: Trippi Troppi (orange cat head on a pink shrimp body) riding the carousel; Orangutini Ananassini (orange orangutan with a pineapple body and leaves on its head) eating cotton candy; Burbaloni Luliloli (brown capybara inside half a coconut) playing a guitar; Cocofanto Elefanto (small brown elephant with a coconut head) playing with a ball; Espressona Signora (old lady in a flowered dress with an espresso cup head) juggling. Around them: a Ferris wheel, a carousel with horses, a cotton candy stand, balloons, game booths with prizes, a little roller coaster, a popcorn cart, string lights, palm trees and seagulls. wide shot, busy scene packed with small distinct objects over the whole picture, no empty areas, everything in sharp focus, all characters medium size and fully visible, cute, no weapons, no text, no logo, no watermark, 4:3, flat 2D cartoon illustration, thick clean black outlines, flat bright colors with simple cel shading, children's comic book style, crisp clear shapes

edicoes.prompt: Edit this image. Make exactly these changes and nothing else: 1) Put a small red bow on the head of the orange cat riding the horse at the bottom left. 2) Make the yellow ukulele played by the capybara in the coconut red. 3) Make the pink cotton candy held by the orangutan blue. 4) Make the red-and-white striped awning of the cotton candy stand in the center green-and-white. 5) Make the red roller coaster car with riders at the top center blue. 6) Make the red popcorn cart on the right blue. Keep the composition, camera, style, colors, lighting and every other detail exactly the same.

notas: Rodada 1: a candidata 2 tinha texto legivel em placas; a 1 tinha o Trippi Troppi mais gato que camarao; a 4 tinha um bicho roxo extra (narval) no chao. Escolhida a 3: os 5 personagens fieis (Trippi Troppi com corpo de camarao montado num cavalinho de carrossel solto, Orangutini com corpo de abacaxi e algodao-doce, Burbaloni na metade do coco com ukulele, Cocofanto com cabeca de coco e bola, Espressona fazendo malabares). Figurantes humanos minusculos no carrinho da montanha-russa. O chao do centro-baixo e quase so areia com pedrinhas (por isso o patinho acrescentado no v2). Nenhum tubarao, nenhuma cena submarina. Os efeitos colaterais (trilhos da montanha-russa no v1, teto do carrossel no v2) sao diferencas grandes nao pedidas: o estudio deve detecta-las como candidatas.
